message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a tool that can fetch documentaries. However, I can suggest some well‑known documentaries on global warming that you might find interesting:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice President Al Gore’s campaign to raise awareness about climate change. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | Follow‑up to the original, covering progress and setbacks in the fight against climate change. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio explores the impacts of climate change and potential solutions. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC documentary that examines the science behind climate change and its global effects. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A documentary that looks at the environmental crisis and possible ways forward. |

If you’d like more details about any of these or help finding where to watch them, just let me know!
